listing.name: Fleet Accounting
listing.summary: Do you like playing with Second-in-Command? Good. Do you struggle to count up to whatever number of Atlases you are casually fielding in your fleet? Me too. Then this mod is for you (and me, I guess).
listing.aiSummary: Adds a setting to display fleet composition statistics regardless of skills and includes civilian ships in the count.

description: Allows all fleet composition data statistics to be enabled in LunaLib settings, showing them even without relevant skills. This ensures visibility of stats like those from Second-in-Command. It also adds civilian ships to the displayed list.
